data.title: ELA Residences
data.about:
A project by Dorchester Collection and managed by Omniyat, Ela Residences is perfectly positioned on the iconic Palm Jumeirah. It is the last property on the island, offering buyers an opportunity to be part of a secret piece of haven on an instantly recognisable symbol of luxury.

You can choose from 3 super penthouses, and 3- and 4-bedroom simplex and duplex units in Ela Dorchester Collection. Famous architect Zaha Hadid has designed this exclusive residential enclave, while the landscaping is done by Vladimir Djurovic. Amenities in Palm Ela Residences include seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces, private pools in each residence, and elevated sun lounging platforms.

characteristics_module.title: Feel The Blend of Natural World at ELA Residencecs
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• A diverse mix of duplex units, dual-aspect layouts, private gardens and pools, and 250 metres of private beachfront.
  • Enjoy a 5-star experience at home with exclusive amenities like valet parking, in-residence catering services, housekeeping, etc.
  • Immerse yourself in the work of world-renowned landscape architect Vladimir Djurovic and Zaha Hadid's visionary designs. Their masterpieces have combined to create this exceptional residence. 
  • From the comfort of your home, you can take in breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, Burj Al Arab, and Burj Khalifa.
  • Ensure your health and wellness, as the residence has 12 private treatment rooms.
  • Flexible payment plan starting from just a 5 per cent downpayment.

location_tile.title: Elevated Living at Ela Residences in Palm Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Ela by Omniyat offers stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, Burj Al Arab, and Burj Khalifa. It is located along the Eastern Crescent of the Palm Jumeirah. As the ultimate landmark in Palm Jumeirah, Ela Residences occupies a prestigious location. The man-made marvel symbolises luxury and innovation in Dubai's skyline. Its palm-shaped design and opulent developments have made it a coveted destination for residents and tourists alike.

  • 04 minutes to Atlantis The Palm
  • 04 minutes to Waldorf Astoria Dubai Palm Jumeirah
  • 12 minutes to Fairmont The Palm
  • 22 minutes to Dubai Marina
